title: Epic New York Cheesecake (BraveTart Style)
description: A tall, rich New York-style cheesecake with a graham cracker crust and ultra-smooth cream cheese filling, inspired by BraveTart.

steps.instruction: Preheat oven and prepare an 8x4-inch cake pan. Grease lightly or line as needed.
Mix graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, and salt. Press into pan to form crust.
Beat cream cheese and goat cheese until completely smooth.
Mix in lemon juice, vanilla, orange flower water, and salt.
Gradually add sugar and mix until fully combined.
Add eggs and mix until smooth and incorporated.
Warm cream and slowly mix into batter until smooth and aerated.
Pour batter into crust and remove air bubbles by tapping pan.
Bake until edges are set and center still slightly wobbly, following staged temperature baking.
Cool gradually: rest in oven, then at room temperature, then refrigerate overnight.
Unmold carefully depending on pan type and transfer to serving plate.
Serve chilled, optionally topped with fresh fruit and syrup.
